title: 第十一章 第二名第十二章 三只铁龙
lines: 废弃矿洞外。
希多里维冷着脸，缓步走近，瞥一眼面前的铬龙。
他心里有些讶异，西隆战斗时所使用的技法，他在旁边看得很清楚。
从错身探爪到闪转腾挪，在极短的时间里两次制住莱杰多雷，每一次都干脆利落，而且取胜之后没有任何得意的神情，说明他心里早有把握。
一条铬龙，怎么会在对战铁龙时早有把握呢？
“你的爪子很好，能撕裂铁龙的鳞片。”
希多里维说，“爪牙锋利、身形灵活，有战斗的理解和应变，那么不管是重质龙还是次龙，都有挑战我们的资格，莱杰多雷这次输给你，不算羞耻。”
“我今天主要是来找你的。”西隆说。
“要休息么？还是已经准备好了。”
希多里维昂然说，眼睛盯着西隆的手爪。
西隆话音落下的时候，两条重质龙同时动了。
钢灰和黑铁两种光芒在烈日下交错，发出金属碰撞般的脆响。
希多里维的动作并不很快，他已经看出西隆的招式，无非就是抓住敌人进攻的间隙，借力使力逼出失误，最后通过扼住对手的要害取胜。
只要对身体的控制足够细致，力量收放自如，就不会轻易踩进铬龙的陷阱。
西隆被猛烈的力量震击，被迫连续后退，希多里维不是弱手，他是雏龙之中排名第二的强大者，即便经过长期训练，单从力量上来说，西隆仍无法胜过这条铁龙。
希多里维眯起眼，在铬龙被震退的瞬间，立刻抓住一个机会，迅速追击，以势不可挡的姿态抓拍，裂风声呜呜作响。
铬龙不敢面对他的巨力，再次后掠退开。
看到这一幕，铁龙们纷纷发出一声低笑，那是希多里维屡试不爽的一击，看似盛气凌人势不可挡，实则根本未尽全力。
他在半空中收招，爪击并未落下，而是用红亮瞳孔，紧紧盯住铬龙闪避的方向，忽然之间猛扑突进，直接去抓铬龙闪避的落点。
希多里维利用这一次爪击，彻底改变战斗节奏，将主动权牢牢掌握在自己手中。
许多铁龙都曾败在他这招之下，只要闪避，就一定会被提前攻击落点，连反击都来不及。
在铁龙们看来，唯一的破解方法，就是像杰利里昂那样不闪不避，迎上去和希多里维硬碰。
但杰利里昂敢这样做，是因为力量强大，自信可以在力量上胜过希多里维。
其他重质龙和次龙，哪个敢在铁龙的爪击面前昂然不退？即使号称重盾的钴龙也做不到吧？
电光石火之间，希多里维已经扑向铬龙的落点，两者一前一后，不过毫秒之差，再闪再避，绝来不及。
铁龙们看到这一幕，心里都觉得希多里维已经赢了。
可是西隆只有前爪落地。
他似乎预判到了希多里维将要追击，借着闪避未消的冲势，双爪铁钳般扣进地面，以前爪为圆心，依靠强劲的腰腹力量，拉动整具身体腾空。
铬龙的身体回旋呼啸，划出一个巨大的圆，像一柄凶猛的链锤横扫。
那条覆满钢灰鳞片的重尾，带着千钧之力，轰击在追击而来的希多里维脸上。
伴随一声沉重的巨响，身长两米的铁龙，与岩石同样沉重，竟然被抽翻出去，横身砸倒。
莫奇大吼助威，振奋得几乎要跳起来，引得许多雏龙侧目。
不知什么时候开始，许多重质龙聚集到了场地周围，钴龙、钨龙、镍龙都有，还有一些次龙躲在远处偷看。
希多里维晃晃脑袋站起，吐出一口污秽的血，牙齿不知道碎了多少颗，受击的下颌骨明显裂了，剧烈的疼痛汹涌而来。
他有些吃惊。
这一下跟杰利里昂的猛击相比也不逞多让了，可对手明明只是一条铬龙，不知是如何挥出这样巨大的力量。
content_en:
Outside the abandoned mine.
With a cold face, Hidorivi walked slowly closer and glanced at the chromium dragon in front of him.
He was a little surprised. He could clearly see the techniques Shillong used during the battle.
From staggering his body and reaching for his claws to dodging and leaping, he restrained Legedore twice in a very short period of time. Each time he was able to do it neatly and without any proud expression after winning, which shows that he was already sure of himself.
How could a chrome dragon be so sure about fighting an iron dragon?
"Your claws are very good and can tear the scales of an iron dragon."
Hidorivi said, "With sharp claws, a flexible body, and the understanding and adaptability of fighting, no matter it is a heavy dragon or a sub-dragon, they are qualified to challenge us. It is not a shame for Legedore to lose to you this time."
"I mainly came to see you today." Shillong said.
"Want to rest? You're still ready."
Hidorivi said proudly, staring at Shillong's paws.
"Come!"
When Xilong finished speaking, the two heavy dragons moved at the same time.
The two lights of steel gray and black iron intersect under the scorching sun, making a crisp sound like metal collision.
Hidorivi's movements are not very fast. He has already seen that Shillong's moves are nothing more than seizing the gap in the enemy's attack, using his strength to force mistakes, and finally winning by strangling the opponent's vital points.
As long as the control of the body is meticulous enough and the power can be freely released, you will not easily step into the trap of the Chrome Dragon.
Shillong was shocked by the violent force and was forced to retreat continuously. Hidorivi was not a weak hand. He was the second most powerful among the young dragons. Even after long-term training, Shillong still could not defeat this iron dragon in terms of strength alone.
Hedorivi narrowed his eyes. The moment the Chrome Dragon was knocked back, he immediately seized an opportunity and quickly pursued it. He captured the picture with an unstoppable attitude, making the sound of cracking wind whine.
The Chrome Dragon did not dare to face his huge strength and once again swept back.
Seeing this scene, the iron dragons all let out a low laugh. It was a strike that Hidorivi had tried many times. It seemed to be overwhelming and unstoppable, but in fact, he did not use his full strength at all.
He retracted his move in mid-air, but the claw attack did not fall. Instead, he used his bright red pupils to focus on the direction of the chrome dragon's dodge, and suddenly swooped forward to directly catch the chromium dragon's dodge landing point.
Hidorivi used this claw attack to completely change the rhythm of the battle and firmly grasp the initiative in his own hands.
Many iron dragons have been defeated by this move. As long as they dodge, they will be attacked in advance, and they will not even have time to counterattack.
In the view of the iron dragons, the only way to defeat him is to confront Hedorivi head-on without dodging like Jelilion did.
But Jellion dared to do this because he was powerful and confident that he could surpass Hedorivi in ​​strength.
Which of the other heavy dragons and sub-dragons dares to stand firm and unyielding in the face of the iron dragon's claw attack? Even the Cobalt Dragon, which is known as a heavy shield, can't do it, right?
In the blink of an eye, Hedorivi had already pounced on the Chrome Dragon's landing point. The two were one behind the other, with only a millisecond difference. It would be too late to dodge and dodge again.
When the iron dragons saw this scene, they felt that Hedorivi had won.
But Shillong only had his front paws on the ground.
He seemed to have predicted that Hidorivi was about to pursue him. With the momentum of his dodge, he dug his claws into the ground like iron pincers. With his forepaws as the center of the circle, he relied on his strong waist and abdominal strength to pull his entire body into the air.
The chrome dragon's body whirled and roared, drawing a huge circle, sweeping across like a ferocious chain hammer.
The heavy tail covered with steel-gray scales struck the pursuing Hedorivi in ​​the face with great force.
With a heavy loud noise, the two-meter-long iron dragon, which was as heavy as the rock, was thrown out and fell sideways.
"Roar!"
Moqi roared in support, almost jumping with excitement, attracting many young dragons to look at him sideways.
I don't know when, many heavy dragons gathered around the venue, including cobalt dragons, tungsten dragons, and nickel dragons, and some subsaurs were hiding in the distance to peek.
Hedorivi shook his head and stood up, vomiting out a mouthful of dirty blood. He didn't know how many teeth were broken. The mandible was obviously cracked by the impact, and severe pain surged through him.
He was a little surprised.
This time, it was not too much compared to Jelilion's punch, but the opponent was obviously just a chrome dragon, and I don't know how he could exert such huge power.
